_purpose: Replayable action: gently scroll the DeepSeek chat tab down a little in the already-running shared Firefox, via the http-mcp BiDi broker (CALL atom). Re-send this exact payload to replay.

params.expression: (async function(){var el=document.querySelector('div.ds-virtual-list.ds-scroll-area')||document.querySelector('.ds-scroll-area');if(!el){return JSON.stringify({error:'scroll container not found'});}var before=el.scrollTop;el.scrollTop=el.scrollTop+400;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));var after=el.scrollTop;return JSON.stringify({before:before,after:after,delta:after-before,scrollHeight:el.scrollHeight,clientHeight:el.clientHeight});})()

notes: Shared socket: never session.new / session.end / DeleteSession (kills all clients).
We address the existing tab by explicit context id rather than claiming a new one, because the action must land on the real DeepSeek tab.
The container is a virtualized list (ds-virtual-list); scrollTop is clamped to currently-rendered content, so near the bottom a large delta may clamp. 400px is gentle and lands.
Confirmation is built in: the JS returns before/after/delta; delta>0 proves the scroll happened.
